title: Bislama - Wikipedia
text: Bislama is the first language of many of the "Urban ni-Vanuatu " (citizens who live in Port Vila and Luganville) and the second language of much of the rest of the country's residents. The lyrics of "Yumi, Yumi, Yumi", the country's national anthem, are composed in Bislama.
